question: Tell me top10 teams with the most wins across the league
sql:
SELECT 
    t.team_api_id,
    t.team_long_name,
    SUM(CASE 
        WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 1 
        ELSE 0 
    END) + 
    SUM(CASE 
        WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 1 
        ELSE 0 
    END) as total_wins
FROM Team t
LEFT JOIN Match m ON (t.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id OR t.team_api_id = m.away_team_api_id)
GROUP BY t.team_api_id, t.team_long_name
ORDER BY total_wins DESC
LIMIT 10
